title: Welcome to the Underground
narrativeText: The arena smells like blood and cheap beer. The crowd doesn't want a match — they want carnage. Tonight, you give them what they came for.

choices.label: Start the Brawl
choices.text: No rules. No referees. Just you and them.

title: Backstage Ambush
narrativeText: {{RIVAL}} jumps you before the show even starts. Chairs fly. The crowd outside can hear the commotion through the walls.

choices.label: Fight Back Right Now
choices.text: No waiting. You return every shot with interest.

choices.label: Bide Your Time
choices.text: Let them think they got the better of you. Your moment will come.

title: The Stash
narrativeText: You find a storage closet packed with steel chairs, tables, and a bag of thumbtacks. Someone left it unlocked. Tonight's tools are ready.

choices.label: Use Everything Tonight
choices.text: Why save them? The crowd wants a Last Man Standing war.

choices.label: Save Them for the Right Moment
choices.text: Patience. The right opponent will come. You pocket the tacks.

title: The Booker's Demand
narrativeText: The underground booker has a simple message: make a statement or go home. {{RIVAL}} is waiting in the ring. The crowd is hungry.

choices.label: Make the Statement
choices.text: No more warm-ups. This is where legends are made.

title: Riot in the Aisle
narrativeText: The guardrail collapses. Fans scatter. The brawl spills from the ring into the crowd. There is no ring anymore — the whole building is the arena. Three other wrestlers are already out here. This has become something else entirely.

choices.label: Join the Riot
choices.text: You dive into the chaos. It's every person for themselves.

choices.label: Reclaim the Ring
choices.text: While everyone brawls outside, you hold the ring. The crowd respects the strategy.

title: The Outsider's Test
narrativeText: A masked figure steps through the curtain. No music. No introduction. They point at you. The underground booker announces: this is an elimination challenge. Beat them, and your name stays on the board. Lose, and you go to the back of the line.

title: Threat on the Locker
narrativeText: Taped to your locker, written in marker on a paper towel: 'You're next. And you won't get up.' No name. No explanation. The smell of sweat and blood fills the room around you.

choices.label: Ignore It
choices.text: Anonymous cowards don't deserve a response. You crumple it and toss it.

choices.label: Post a Counter-Threat
choices.text: You write your own note and pin it to the corkboard where everyone will see it.

title: The Parking Lot Chant
narrativeText: Outside the venue, a group of fans in the parking lot starts chanting your name before the show even starts. Word must have spread. They are here for you — holding handmade signs, wearing your colors, waiting.

choices.label: Stop and Acknowledge Them
choices.text: You walk over. Slap hands. Point to the building. They roar.

choices.label: Walk Past in Character
choices.text: You're the bad guy tonight. No time for sentiment.
